THE PURPOSE BEHIND THE PROCESS

Re-Inspection:
a clearly defined scope.

Close the loop with evidence. Check the reported work rather than relying only on a verbal assurance that it is complete.

What We Review & Document

  • Previous defects verification
  • Rectification status
  • New visible observations
  • Before/after comparison where applicable

What’s Included

  • Updated report
  • Updated inspection status
  • A record of items requiring further attention

Who Needs This Service?

  • Owners after builder rectification
  • Buyers verifying handover repairs
  • Clients with a previous inspection or defect record
Timing & duration

Visit duration is confirmed after reviewing property size, access and the agreed scope.

Assessment is limited to the agreed scope, safe access and conditions at the time of the visit. It is not a structural stability certificate, absolute safety certification or guarantee against concealed defects.

Critical

Potentially serious safety or property concern requiring prompt professional attention.

Major

Significant defect requiring corrective action.

Moderate

Noticeable defect affecting quality or functionality.

Minor

Low-impact or primarily cosmetic observation.

A FEW USEFUL ANSWERS

Questions about
Re-Inspection.

What should I share before re-inspection?+

Share the previous report or defect list and the rectification information. This helps define the follow-up scope and relevant comparison points.

Is re-inspection a guarantee that every issue is resolved?+

No. It records accessible conditions and the status of the agreed items at the time of the visit. New or concealed concerns may require separate scope.

Inspection Disclaimer

CivicQC inspection services are intended to identify observable and instrument-assisted construction, workmanship, moisture, finishing and functional concerns within the defined inspection scope. An inspection does not guarantee the absence of concealed defects and should not be represented as a structural stability certificate or absolute safety certification unless a separately qualified service is specifically provided. Specialized laboratory testing and engineering assessments may be subject to separate scope and charges.
